title: File:RAF Search and Rescue Helicopter in the Cairngorms MOD 45155350.jpg
author: SAC Faye Storer
description:
A Royal Air Force (RAF) Search and Rescue (SAR) helicopter with D Flight No. 202 Squadron RAF from RAF Lossiemouth is pictured during a training exercise in the Cairngorm mountain range in Scotland.  Royal Air Force Search and Rescue crews train throughout the year at different locations and in different weather conditions.
